title: Okinawa: Oscar Pettiford and Skeeter Best fight
summary: On the plane Oscar slaps Skeeter, who punches him; Oscar is sent home and a Filipino bassist replaces him.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Okinawa. Of course, the famous story that came out of it was Oscar and Skeeter having the fight.
Yeah. Well, we were on the plane getting ready to leave Okinawa, and Oscar... All of a sudden, that

liquor told him that he was the boss in there, and he could do anything he wanted to do, and he told Skeeter to shut up, and Skeeter wouldn't, because Skeeter had been drinking too. And they had been hangin'-out buddies and been getting drunk every day together and everything. So all of a sudden, Oscar turned around and decided he wanted to stop... I think he was showin' off for the people that was in the plane, that he was Oscar Pettiford. So he slapped Skeeter. And Skeeter jumped up and hit him right in the eye, boom, and his eye jumped out like that, man! So they had to turn around and take the plane back and put them off. And they sent us on to Manila.
I remember reading you got a Philippine bass player.

Yeah, we got a Philippine bass player. They sent a guitar player on down to the rest of the band. They sent Oscar back to Honolulu to send him over to New York. And we had a Philippine boy that played bass. He couldn't play that good, but we needed a bass anyway.
Did you hear any good musicians in the Orient?
Not at that time, no. Not a thing. The bass player that we got, if you heard the records, you know that he didn't know what the hell was going on. But what
the hell, you know; we made the trip -- that's the main thing.
